basic_info.description: Perfectly positioned on a prized front lot along 6th Avenue (Single Family Home in rear at 373 6th Ave is also available for sale), this beautifully reimagined single-family home combines timeless design with modern comfort in one of San Francisco's most sought-after neighborhoods. Originally rebuilt in 2010, the home features 3 bedrooms and 3 baths in a bright, open layout with hardwood floors, two fireplaces, skylights, and recessed lighting throughout. The main level centers around an inviting chef's kitchen with a granite island, custom cabinetry, and top-quality stainless steel appliancesideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Upstairs, the primary suite offers a private balcony, dual sinks, and a spa-inspired soaking tub. Each bathroom showcases designer stone tile and upscale fixtures, adding a touch of luxury throughout. Step outside to a peaceful courtyard perfect for morning coffee or outdoor dining. The oversized 3-car garage provides exceptional storage (1 car for rear house). Just a short stroll from Clement Street, the Presidio, and Golden Gate Park, you'll enjoy easy access to some of San Francisco's best cafs, shops, and open spaces. Available individually or together with 373 6th Avenue, offering approximately 4,000 sq. ft. of combined living space
